title: Normalized residue coordinates for the coefficient unit and Tate line
statement: Let l be prime, Y a scheme with l invertible, c Chern data, r a strict scalar restriction, k normalized coefficient cones [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients], and n≥0. A SupportedFiniteBoundaryFrame consists of two ordinary module-sheaf isomorphisms: the evaluated coefficient unit to the constant residue module Z/l^(n+1), and the evaluated coefficient line to the residue Tate line [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface], both restricted through diagonalResidueProjection [det-prop-diagonal-tower-system]. On every local coefficient section heterogeneously equal to its system-ring one, the first isomorphism sends it to the sheafification of residue one. After forgetting scalars, the second isomorphism is k.lineForget followed by the actual cartierProRootMap [lem-sp-cartier-reduction-site-comparison]. Restriction is as in [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models] and the Chern datum is as in [def-sp-tower-class-chern].
